research.text:
**Verdict: DROP_EVERYTHING**

### Reachable Plan
* **Thursday Evening:** Drive from Denver to Steamboat Springs via I-70 and US-40 over Rabbit Ears Pass. 
* **Friday (Primary Day):** Line up early for the 09:00 reopening. Follow staged patrol rope drops from mid-mountain into the deep steep trees (Shadows, Closets) and upper bowls as they clear.
* **Saturday (Bonus/Refill Day):** With an overnight refill of 12", stay a second night (est. ~$180; total trip ~$360, well inside your ~$800 benchmark). Ski the morning untracked, then depart early afternoon to beat I-70 weekend congestion.

### Why This Matters to You
A full-day storm closure on Thursday banked 14 inches of daytime snow, topped with 6 inches overnight into Friday. That offers a rare 20-inch untouched weekday reset with zero prior tracks. Temperatures remain below freezing, preserving Steamboat’s signature dry snow across the aspens. An additional foot overnight into Saturday creates back-to-back deep days suited for aggressive steep tree skiing without exhausting your 15 PTO days.

### Practical Alternatives
* **One-and-Done (Friday Only):** Ski Friday’s 20" post-closure opening and head home Friday evening. You avoid Saturday weekend crowds, cut lodging in half, and preserve weekend family/downtime.
* **Stay Front Range (Winter Park/Copper):** Saves the 3.5–4 hour drive and lodging cost entirely, but forfeits 20 inches of unskied post-closure terrain.

### Evidence Breakdown
* **What is Known:** Steamboat closed Thursday (banking 14"), adds 6" for Friday morning, and plans a 09:00 Friday reopening with staged patrol releases. Saturday projects 12" opening snow. Ikon Pass terms confirm Steamboat does not require lift reservations.
* **What is Inferred:** Staged openings mean upper-mountain steeps and hike-to chutes will open later Friday morning as avy mitigation finishes. Friday will see moderate weekday crowds, whereas Saturday will experience standard weekend congestion.
* **What Needs Checking (Overturning Assumptions):** 
  * **Pass Road Conditions:** Check CDOT (cotrip.org) for US-40 over Rabbit Ears Pass Thursday afternoon; high-wind drifting can trigger abrupt closures, requiring a detour via Gore Pass/CO-131.
  * **Terrain Status:** Confirm Steamboat's morning lift-dispatch report for expected lift lines and tree/bowl mitigation progress.
